reason_not_executed: MX /mnt/storage_pool 100% full (~420MB free, 94% inodes) and all 8 A100-PCIE-40GB occupied by unrelated jobs at audit time. No exclusive GPU + no storage => harness is EXECUTION-GATED (refuses to run). This protocol is the deliverable; execution awaits an exclusive GPU and free storage.
supersedes_missing_artifact: The historical 132-job (confirmatory_accel15_11s3) per-run frozen protocol file was NOT locatable on MX or EPIC-05 at audit time. This is a NEW, self-contained, executable protocol for fresh confirmation. It does NOT claim to reproduce the historical 132-job runs.

platform.cohort_rule: Never merge hardware cohorts. A100-40GB result only.

usable_env.note: torch 2.7.1 is closest to the historical 2.7.0+cu128 lineage. Default `python3` on MX has a BROKEN torch (no __version__/cuda) and MUST NOT be used.

inaccessible_env.status: root-owned; 'Permission denied' for liaoyuanjun; no passwordless sudo
inaccessible_env.implication: Any historical run that used the root gsplat env cannot be reproduced as liaoyuanjun without env recreation. Record env per run.

platform.abi_note_R28B: The R28-B ABI failure class is isolated to prebuilt HiGS/native rasterizers built with the wrong C++ ABI. nerficg uses cxx11_abi=1; strong_native uses cxx11_abi=0. A prebuilt rasterizer's ABI must match the chosen env. This is an ENVIRONMENT/ABI issue, not a gsplat-source issue: gsplat 1.5.3 imports cleanly in all three envs. It does not block a fresh gsplat experiment provided the rasterizer is built/selected to match the env ABI.

split_isolation.rule: NO hyperparameter or method selection using held-out test views. Development (Room/Bicycle/Garden) is a DEV split only. Final confirmation uses the 11-scene held-out set with pre-registered gates.
split_isolation.train_views: used for gradient + densification decisions only
split_isolation.val_views: used ONLY for time-to-quality (TTQ) checkpoints and early-stop decisions; never fed back into method choice
split_isolation.heldout_test_views: used ONLY for final PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS; never seen during training or method selection

training_plan.initialization: from_sfm (identical SfM point cloud per scene, identical init for all arms)
training_plan.seed_policy: same seed across arms within a cell for pairing; confirmatory uses >=3 seeds (0,1,2)
training_plan.camera_sequence: fixed shuffled order per (scene,seed), identical across arms

native_baseline.description: stock gsplat 30K training, full densification, no sparsity, no pruning beyond opacity-reset

opacity_pruning_control.description: stock densification + periodic opacity pruning at a FIXED budget (no error guidance). This is the simple control the new method must substantially beat.
opacity_pruning_control.expected: some speedup, quality cost; defines the naive bar

strong_candidate.description: fused render + opacity pruning every 10th densification event + radius_clip 0.05. If the implementation cannot be restored to a verifiable SHA256-pinned checkout, this arm is marked UNRESTORED and excluded — it is NOT substituted.
strong_candidate.expected: 1.164x wall on A100 (historical aggregate); included only when reproducible

codex_candidate.role: candidate under test (received via Codex manifest)

timing_contract.wall_clock_boundary: first training iter to final checkpoint save (dataset_ready_to_final_checkpoint)
metrics_per_run: time_to_quality_seconds (first iter reaching val PSNR >= native_baseline_final - 0.5dB)
timing_contract.gpu_trace: nsys or torch profiler trace per arm (raw artifact, not aggregated)

final_30k.note: 5K alone CANNOT claim final pass. These are full-training targets.

anti_leakage.no_test_tuning: enforced by split_isolation; any per-test-view method change voids the run
